Weather Data

Source: vignettes/weather_data.qmd

1 Introduction

This vignette explains how to retrieve and organize weather data for ecotourism analysis in Australia.
We identify the top 3 weather stations associated with each focal organism and optionally download 10 years of daily weather data (2014–2024) for each.

This is the glimpse of your data :

2 Map of Top Weather Stations 

top_stations |> left_join(weather_stations) |> 
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = oz_lga) +
  geom_point(aes(x = stn_lon, y = stn_lat, color = organism), shape = 17, size = 3)
  theme_minimal()
